notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Jumbo Cactuar.
easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Brightmare by paying {2}{W}.
When Brightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Jumbo Cactuar's power.
